original.text: brahma satyaṃ jagan mithyā jīvo brahmaiva nāparaḥ / anena vedyaṃ sacchāstram iti vedāntaḍiṇḍimaḥ
original.edition: vulgate wording recalled from memory (verify against an edition)

paraphrase: Brahman is real, the world is false, the jīva is Brahman alone and not other; by this the right teaching is to be known — this is the drum-beat of Vedānta.
notes: Verse number moderate confidence. Attributed to Śaṅkara (doubtful).
